fact: The Business Registration Service says name reservation and business registration are merged into one step, with three preferred names and the full application submitted online.
The article says Pesaflow is associated in Kenya with eCitizen and the Business Registration Service, with services to file applications, pay fees and retrieve documents online.

The Business Registration Service says IFC support covered digitization of all Company Registry records, an electronic document management system and integration of the companies, e-collateral, hire purchase and Official Receiver registries.

The Business Registration Service's development-partners page, as captured in June 2026, lists among its outcomes an online Beneficial Ownership Information Register operationalised for private companies with GIZ support.

Kenyans.co.ke reports the Business Registration Service launched its BRS Version II online portal on eCitizen on 16 February 2026 for company changes, and digital downloadable certificates have replaced physical ones.
